proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Generous sign-up credits (approx. 14 CNY / $2 USD) plus daily free login credits. FLUX.1-schnell costs only ~0.01 CNY per image, giving thousands of free generations.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides high-speed API endpoints for FLUX.1-schnell, SD3, and state-of-the-art LLMs. It bypasses GitHub Actions IP bans (unlike AI Horde) and is significantly cheaper/more reliable than standard US-based providers.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Replace current broken image pipelines (e.g., `produce_coloring_book` or `produce_merch_designs`) by switching the API endpoint from Together/Cloudflare to SiliconFlow with simple cURL or Python requests.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Documentation is sometimes partially in Chinese, but the API is fully OpenAI-compatible. Subject to future promotional tier changes.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 1,000,000 free tokens per month via API.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Converts any URL (including search results, e-commerce listings, or blog posts) into clean, LLM-friendly Markdown. Perfect for feeding raw web data directly into Gemini-2.5-flash.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Integration into market analysis agents (e.g., `agent_eclaireur_bestsellers` or `agent_trend_explosion`) to scrape and understand live trends directly from GitHub Actions without needing complex headless browsers.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Some highly protected sites (like Etsy or Amazon) might still trigger Cloudflare challenge blocks, requiring proxy rotations.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 2,500 free Google Search / Google Images / Google Shopping queries on signup.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: An extremely fast, reliable, and cheap Google Search API. It allows automated scraping of Google Trends, autocomplete keywords, and Google Shopping prices.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Used in `agent_niche_gap` and `agent_opportunity_hunter` to programmatically fetch search volumes, related search terms, and current product pricing to identify low-competition niches.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Credits do not auto-renew monthly (one-time signup credit), but multiple free accounts can be cycled if needed, or topped up extremely cheaply.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100% free to publish and distribute. They take a 10% cut of the retail price only when a sale occurs.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Distributes digital books, EPUBs, and paperbacks to dozens of major platforms (Apple Books, Kobo, Barnes & Noble, Scribd, Tolino) simultaneously from a single dashboard.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Used at the end of the `agent_publisher` pipeline to distribute generated books (like the chess book, roman chapters, or low-content notebooks) wide, rather than relying solely on Amazon KDP.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Strict formatting requirements for interior files; automatic EPUB conversion can sometimes mess up complex image-heavy layouts like coloring books.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free to upload and host unlimited 3D models. Offers a creator membership program with competitive fee splits.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: The fastest-growing 3D model search engine and community. It indexes and matches geometries, making it highly discoverable for 3D printing enthusiasts.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Used alongside Cults3D in `produce_stl_parametric` or `produce_stl_openscad` to double the distribution footprint of Hugo's gamedev/3D assets with zero extra coding.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Very competitive niche; requires proper tagging and descriptions to stand out in their native geometric search engine.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100% free, open-source (Apache 2.0 license). Runs entirely locally.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: A state-of-the-art text-to-speech model with only 82 million parameters that outputs studio-quality, highly natural human speech. Because it is so lightweight, it can run directly inside a free GitHub Actions runner without a GPU.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Can be integrated into a new script `produce_audiobook_or_shorts` to generate high-quality voiceovers for social media marketing videos (TikTok/YouTube Shorts) or audiobooks to package with KDP books.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires Python dependencies (ONNX runtime) to be installed in the GitHub Actions workflow, which can slightly increase runner startup time.
